title: Configuration bit observation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean string of length $n$, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. For a work-tape coordinate $(i,j,b)$, the observed bit records whether cell $j-s$ on tape $i$ contains false when $b=0$, contains true when $b=1$, or has the tape head at $j-s$ when $b=2$. At every other codec-bit coordinate, it is the corresponding bit of the row encoding of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
$x$ is a Boolean string with length $n$
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
